Title: Jiron Form Builder
Description: Jiron Form Builder brings forms to Umbraco 17: designed in the backoffice, filled in on any page, and kept in one calm place afterwards. Editors build forms in a Form Builder section with pages, rules and actions; visitors fill them in on the website, rendered with Razor or headless; the site's team reviews the entries, approves and exports them, and keeps personal data in check. Free to use and change, including commercially; no selling, no published versions of your own (free or paid, open source or not), no competing products; source-available.
